import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'store.db'

def _remove_cart_rows(conn, cart_id):
    # Look up the cart owner and its item count for logging purposes
    owner = conn.execute('SELECT customer_id FROM carts WHERE id = ?', (cart_id,)).fetchone()
    prior = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id = ?', (cart_id,)).fetchone()
    print(f'Removing cart {cart_id} owner={owner[0] if owner else None} items={prior[0]}')
    items = conn.execute('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id = ?', (cart_id,)).rowcount
    carts = conn.execute('DELETE FROM carts WHERE id = ?', (cart_id,)).rowcount
    return (items, carts)

@function_tool
def delete_abandoned_cart_items(cart_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        items, carts = _remove_cart_rows(conn, cart_id)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if carts == 0:
        return f'Cart {cart_id} was not found.'
    return f'Deleted cart {cart_id} and {items} item(s).'
